name: local_camera_snapshot
description: Capture a single high-resolution frame from any RTSP-capable LAN camera (Tapo, Wyze, Reolink, etc.). Reads the camera's RTSP URL from configs/smart_home_tools.json[local_cameras][devices] by alias. Frame is written to data/local_camera_snapshots/ and a snapshot-captured event fires for analyzer subscribers.

inputs.name: camera_alias
inputs.description: Configured device alias (case-insensitive) — e.g. 'Bedroom', 'Front Hall'. See the planner-facing description for the configured list.

inputs.name: timeout_seconds
inputs.description: ffmpeg timeout for the RTSP pull. Default 15s.

outputs.description: Absolute filesystem path to the saved JPEG.

arguments_prompt:
Use this tool to capture one frame from a configured LAN RTSP camera.

Required:
- `camera_alias`: the alias (case-insensitive) of the configured device. The
  planner-facing description for this tool lists the currently-configured
  aliases. Do NOT invent aliases — they must match what's in
  `configs/smart_home_tools.json[local_cameras][devices]`.

Optional:
- `timeout_seconds`: integer, default 15. Bumping helps slow networks; lowering
  fails fast when the camera is offline.

Examples:
- `{"camera_alias": "Bedroom"}`
- `{"camera_alias": "Front Hall", "timeout_seconds": 30}`
